name: Rune hound
description: a stone hound statue come to life: a lean dog carved from pale grey carved stone with glowing cyan runes, from the Rune Bridges of Hell running along its flanks, a heavy stone collar with one big glowing cyan rune on it, blank stone eyes that glow cyan, four legs on the ground

poses.stand: standing on all four legs side-on, head low, the rune on its collar glowing
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: stands still as a statue, then its head turns slowly, runes glowing

move.action: trots forward on all four stone legs, runes flickering along its flanks, staying in the same spot in the frame

attack.action: crouches low, then lunges forward to the right with its stone jaws open, then pulls up

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
